title: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations — all power given him, and the sheep sought where they were scattered (Matthew 10 and 15; Hosea 1; Isaiah 11; James 1)
summary:
It ain't new. The risen one sends the eleven with a word about power and a word about nations:

*And Yahusha (Jesus) came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.* (Matthew 28:18)

*Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit):* (Matthew 28:19)

*All power is given unto me*: given, by the Father, and Daniel had already seen the giving:

*And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.* (Daniel 7:14)

Then *all nations*. Before his death the sending had a fence on it, and he told the twelve who they were sent to:

*These twelve Yahusha (Jesus) sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not:* (Matthew 10:5)

*But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).* (Matthew 10:6)

*But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).* (Matthew 15:24)

The sheep did not change after the rising; the fence came down, because the sheep were out past it. The prophets had said where the lost sheep of the house were: in the nations, under another name, waiting to be called sons again:

*Yet the number of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living Elohim (God).* (Hosea 1:10)

*And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah (Lord) shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.* (Isaiah 11:11)

*And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel), and gather together the dispersed of Yahudah (Judah) from the four corners of the earth.* (Isaiah 11:12)

*And say unto them, Thus saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:* (Ezekiel 37:21)

Paul quotes Hosea's verse for the ones he was sent to:

*And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living Elohim (God).* (Romans 9:26)

And the letters are addressed to the same people in the same places. James writes to the tribes, Peter to the scattered:

*James, a servant of Elohim (God) and of the Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Lord Jesus Christ), to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.* (James 1:1)

*Peter, an apostle of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,* (1 Peter 1:1)

*All nations* is where the sheep are, not who the sheep are. The errand is the one errand, the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), now sought in every place they were driven to, because the death that frees the divorced house has been died. The nations themselves come up to the mountain in the reign, to be taught, and that is a different hour and a different verse:

*And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of Yahuah (LORD), and to the house of the Elohim (God) of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of Yahuah (LORD) from Jerusalem.* (Micah 4:2)

The gospel of the kingdom goes to all nations for a witness, and the end comes when the sheep in them have heard:

*And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.* (Matthew 24:14)

3166.prose: All power is given to the same Yahusha (Jesus) who first put a fence on the twelve. Before the cross he told them not to go *into the way of the Gentiles*. The sheep he sends them after now are the sheep he named then. The fence comes down only because the sheep are out past it.
3166.phrase: Go not into the way of the Gentiles
3166.sentence: The fence on the twelve names who they were sent to, and the sheep behind it are the same sheep the risen one sends them after.

3168.prose: Before he ever says that power is given, Yahusha (Jesus) is already walking ground Isaiah spoke of, the country of the northern tribes by the sea. Matthew points back to the prophet's word and sets the first light there. The land the commission later spreads over was marked out in the old writings long before.
3168.phrase: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Isaiah the prophet
3168.sentence: Matthew sends us back to Isaiah's own words for the land of the northern tribes, where the light first came.

3169.prose: Isaiah says where the hand of Yahuah (Lord) reaches. He sets it out *the second time* to recover the remnant of his people from Assyria, Egypt, Cush, Elam and the islands of the sea. Those are the places the risen one sends the eleven into. The nations in that list are where the people were left, not who the people are.
3169.phrase: shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people
3169.sentence: The recovery of the remnant from Assyria, Egypt, Cush and the islands names the territories the sending goes out to.

3170.prose: The word that comes to Ezekiel opens the two sticks. Yahudah (Judah) is written on one, Joseph and Ephraim on the other, and in his hand they become one stick. Power given to the risen one is power to do that joining. The sending after it goes toward the scattered house, the other stick, and not toward some new people.
3170.phrase: The word of Yahuah (LORD) came again unto me
3170.sentence: The word to Ezekiel opens the two sticks being made one, which is the work the sending after the rising carries on.

3171.prose: The new covenant is made with the house of Yashar'el (Israel) and the house of Yahudah (Judah), and what it puts in them is the law itself, written on the heart. So when the risen one tells the eleven to teach them to observe all he commanded, the covenant he teaches is Torah kept, not Torah laid down. The houses named here are the houses the sheep belong to.
3171.phrase: I will make a new covenant with the house of Yashar'el (Israel)
3171.sentence: The new covenant is made with the house of Yashar'el (Israel) and the house of Yahudah (Judah), the houses the sent ones are sent to.

3173.prose: Paul takes Hosea's word and says it of the ones he was sent to. Those who were not a people are the scattered house, called again by name in the place they were driven to. So the all nations of the commission is the place of that calling, and the ones called are the house.
3173.phrase: I will call them my people, which were not my people
3173.sentence: Hosea's word of calling those who were not a people is spoken of the scattered house, which tells who the sending is for.

3175.prose: Here the nations are a place people came from. The ones standing in Jerusalem are Yahudim (Jews), scattered and drawn back for the feast, and each hears the word in the language of the land he lives in. Every nation under heaven is where the scattered seed was found, and the sending after the rising goes to them there.
3175.phrase: Yahudim (Jews), devout men, out of every nation under heaven
3175.sentence: Yahudim (Jews) from every nation under heaven show the all nations of the commission to be the lands the scattered were found in.

3176.prose: Those scattered after Stephen carried the word as far as Phenice, Cyprus and Antioch, and gave it to the Yahudim (Jews) only. The sheep stayed the sheep, even when the road ran through the nations. The commission to all nations is a road, and who stood at the end of the road did not change.
3176.phrase: preaching the word to none but unto the Yahudim (Jews) only
3176.sentence: The scattered carry the word through Phenice, Cyprus and Antioch to the Yahudim (Jews) only, so the road through the nations was still for the house.

3177.prose: The power given to him is what carries this word everywhere. It goes out to the nations as a witness, and when the sheep in them have heard it, the end comes. The nations are where the word is heard, and the sheep are the ones who hear.
3177.phrase: shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations
3177.sentence: The gospel of the kingdom goes to every nation as a witness, and the end waits on the sheep in them hearing it.

3179.prose: James writes to a people, the twelve tribes, and he finds them scattered abroad. The commission to every nation is the same sending, and this letter lands on the same people in the same lands. A servant of Yahusha (Jesus) is writing to the sheep, not to a new nation.
3179.phrase: to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad
3179.sentence: James addresses the twelve tribes scattered abroad, the same sheep in the same lands the sending goes to.

3181.prose: Elohim (God) went to redeem Yashar'el (Israel) out of Egypt, from the nations and their gods. Bringing a people out from among the nations is old work. So when all power is given and the sending goes to all nations, it goes to bring the redeemed people out from among them, not to turn the nations into that people.
3181.phrase: whom Elohim (God) went to redeem for a people to himself
3181.sentence: Elohim (God) redeemed Yashar'el (Israel) out from the nations, which is how the sending to the nations now is to be read.

3182.prose: The one who says all power is given is the one Daniel saw brought near to the Ancient of days. What he receives there is dominion, glory and a kingdom, and the nations are named as those who serve it. Daniel keeps the word *like*, one like the Son of Adam, and the giving is the Father's. Nothing in it turns the nations into the people.
3182.phrase: one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven
3182.sentence: Daniel sees one like the Son of Adam brought before the Ancient of days, the giving behind the power Yahusha (Jesus) names.

3183.prose: Micah sees a later hour. The nations come up themselves to the mountain of Yahuah (LORD), to be taught his ways and to walk his paths, and the law goes out from Zion. That is a different day from the sending. In the commission he goes out after the sheep where they are. In the last days the nations flow to the mountain.
3183.phrase: the mountain of the house of Yahuah (LORD) shall be established in the top of the mountains
3183.sentence: In the last days the nations flow to the mountain of Yahuah (LORD) to be taught, a later hour than the sending after the sheep.

3184.prose: The Torah was spoken long before the sending. Yahuah (LORD) says to keep judgment and do justice, because his salvation is near, and the next verse blesses the one who keeps the sabbath. The teaching of all he commanded is that same keeping. Nothing in the power given is power to put the law down.
3184.phrase: Keep ye judgment, and do justice
3184.sentence: Yahuah (LORD) calls for keeping judgment and doing justice, and the teaching to observe all things is that same keeping of Torah.

7021.prose: Luke gives the twelve power and authority over devils and disease, and Matthew tells where they were to take it. Not *into the way of the Gentiles*, and not into a Samaritan city, but to the lost sheep. The power is for the sheep, and the fence tells whose they are.
7021.phrase: Go not into the way of the Gentiles
7021.sentence: The twelve are sent with power, and the word to them fences the road toward the lost sheep of the house.

5272.prose: The servant's own work is named first: raise up the tribes of Jacob and restore the preserved of Yashar'el (Israel). The light to the nations is given beside it. So the gospel published among all nations is the servant's work carried into the lands where the tribes were scattered.
5272.phrase: to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Yashar'el (Israel)
5272.sentence: The servant's own errand is to raise up the tribes and restore the preserved of Yashar'el (Israel), and the light to the nations is the reach of that errand.

7051.prose: Luke has them coming from the four quarters, and Matthew says whose table it is, the table of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. The many come to the fathers from every direction, which is how the prophets speak of the scattered coming home. The centurion standing there heard and believed, seed revealed by hearing.
7051.phrase: many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob
7051.sentence: The many come from east and west to sit with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, the scattered seed gathered to the fathers' table.

5271.prose: Hosea says the calling happens in the very place the people were told they were not his. Among all nations is that place. The gospel is published there because that is where the sons of the living Elohim (God) are waiting to be called sons again.
5271.phrase: in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people
5271.sentence: The word of sonship is said in the place the people were told they were not his, which is the nations.

7125.prose: Luke has the word going out among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem, and Matthew has the sending that carries it. The going is toward the places the scattered were driven. What is taught there is told in the next line: to observe all he commanded. That is Torah kept, carried to the lost sheep wherever they are.
7125.phrase: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations
7125.sentence: The sending goes to every nation, where the scattered are, and the teaching it carries is the keeping of all he commanded.

5269.prose: Mark has the gospel going out to every nation first, and Matthew says what it is and what follows. It is the gospel of the kingdom, it goes out *for a witness*, and after that the end. The nations are where it is published. The word is for the sheep scattered in them, and when they have heard, the end comes.
5269.phrase: this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world
5269.sentence: The gospel of the kingdom is published to all nations for a witness, and the end follows once it has been heard.

5270.prose: Mark's *all nations* is the same all nations Matthew gives the eleven. It is the territory, the lands where the scattered seed was driven, and not a new kind of people to be turned into the people. What is taught there is told in the next line: observe all things he commanded.
5270.phrase: teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father
5270.sentence: Go and teach all nations is the same sending as the gospel published among all nations, aimed at the places the sheep are scattered.

5377.prose: Go into all the world, and Isaiah says what the world is for: the tribes of Jacob raised up, the preserved of Yashar'el (Israel) brought back, and a light given to the nations. The reach is the whole earth because the scattered are all over it.
5377.phrase: that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth
5377.sentence: The salvation reaches the end of the earth because the tribes to be restored are scattered that far.

5376.prose: Go into all the world, and Hosea says what is waiting there. The children of Yashar'el (Israel) are as the sand of the sea, and a word is spoken to them in the very place they were cast off. The preaching goes out after sons, and the whole world is simply where they lie.
5376.phrase: Ye are the sons of the living Elohim (God)
5376.sentence: The scattered are told they are sons in the place they were told otherwise, so the whole world is the field they lie in.

5375.prose: Go into all the world only makes sense from the one who says this. The power is given him, and the sending rides on it. It is given by the Father, as Daniel saw. What goes out under it is the one errand to the lost sheep, now sought wherever they were driven.
5375.phrase: All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth
5375.sentence: The power given to him in heaven and earth is what stands behind the going into all the world.

5378.prose: Go into all the world and preach, and the ones who hear are the sheep. He does not say the hearing makes them sheep. He says they hear because they are his, and he knows them. The word goes out to every creature, and the sheep in the world know the voice when it reaches them.
5378.phrase: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them
5378.sentence: The sheep hear his voice and follow, so the preaching in all the world finds the sheep who are already his.

5392.prose: Mark ends with the sent ones going out and Yahusha (Jesus) working with them. Acts shows it in Iconium. They speak boldly, and Yahuah (Lord) gives testimony to the word with signs and wonders by their hands. The sending is carried out in the cities where the scattered live, beginning in their synagogues.
5392.phrase: gave testimony unto the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders
5392.sentence: Yahuah (Lord) gives testimony to the word with signs and wonders by their hands, as Mark's ending says Yahusha (Jesus) worked with them.

5393.prose: The signs following are not the sent ones' own. Elohim (God) wrought them, by the hands of Paul. So the confirming Mark names is Elohim (God) at work through those who carry the word out to the scattered.
5393.phrase: Elohim (God) wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul
5393.sentence: Elohim (God) works the miracles by the hands of Paul, the confirming Mark's ending says followed those who went out.

5394.prose: Hebrews says the word began to be spoken by Yahusha (Jesus) himself and was confirmed by those who heard him. That is Mark's ending in a sentence: they went out, he worked with them, and the word was confirmed. The next verse adds that Elohim (God) bore them witness with signs and wonders.
5394.phrase: began to be spoken by Yahusha (Lord), and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him
5394.sentence: The word began with Yahusha (Jesus) and was confirmed by those who heard him, which is the going out Mark's ending describes.
